statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-119372 is a use-after-free in fts3BestSnippet() in SQLite's FTS3/FTS4 extension: a MATCH query combining OR and NEAR with snippet() reads freed position-list memory. SQLite lists it as fixed in 3.54.0 for builds with FTS3/FTS4 and SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS3_PARENTHESIS: https://sqlite.org/cves.html, https://sqlite.org/bugs/info/2026-08-17T09:18:24Z. The trunk fix is check-in https://sqlite.org/src/info/e4635c4153, mirrored as https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/commit/a87bd2471a9c0606e78d3c3678bcd9cecaa0e731, and the same change on the 3.53 maintenance branch is https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/commit/aa661c2e67df2f6c02df18ca7ba1682cfed607ea, which makes fts3BestSnippet() in ext/fts3/fts3_snippet.c iterate over the query expression with fts3SnippetFindPositions a second time; it was committed after the 3.53.4 release. DHI's 3.53.4-r1 build is SQLite 3.53.4 with a backport of the branch commit. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository publishes packages built from source sqlite (sqlite, sqlite-libs, sqlite-static, sqlite-dev and sqlite-doc) at 3.51.1-r0, 3.51.2-r0, 3.53.4-r0 and 3.53.4-r1, for x86_64 and aarch64. We unpacked the sqlite, sqlite-libs, sqlite-static and sqlite-dev packages of every one of those builds on both architectures, each checked against its index checksum. SQLite is compiled into three files in each build: the sqlite3 shell in the sqlite package, which carries its own copy and does not link libsqlite3; the shared library in sqlite-libs; and the static archive libsqlite3.a in sqlite-static. sqlite-dev holds only headers, a pkg-config file and the libsqlite3.so link. The shell and both libraries report SQLite 3.51.1, 3.51.2, 3.53.4 and 3.53.4 in those builds. The 3.51.1-r0, 3.51.2-r0 and 3.53.4-r0 builds are built from the upstream 3.51.1, 3.51.2 and 3.53.4 releases, none of which contains the fix. The affected configuration is compiled in: the compile-option list in the shell and both libraries of every build includes ENABLE_FTS3, ENABLE_FTS4 and ENABLE_FTS3_PARENTHESIS. The shared library and the shell are stripped, so we compared the compiled code of the static archive libsqlite3.a, which keeps its function names, in every build on x86_64 and aarch64: fts3SnippetFunc(), into which fts3BestSnippet() is inlined, refers to the fts3SnippetFindPositions callback twice as often in 3.53.4-r1 as in 3.53.4-r0, on both architectures, which is the second pass the fix adds. The shell and the shared library in 3.53.4-r1 are built from the same patched source, and the reproducible fixes in the same build (for example CVE-2026-119371) behave as fixed in all three copies. So 3.51.1-r0, 3.51.2-r0 and 3.53.4-r0 are affected and 3.53.4-r1 is fixed.
